# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 34 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_015_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 15

**1** Jesus said: "When you see one who was not born [жпо] of a woman [сhіме], fall on your face and worship [оуошт] him. That one is your Father."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *жпо*: to beget, give birth; "born of a woman" = born through normal human generation
- *сhіме*: woman; the standard of human birth
- The "one not born of woman" = the Father / the divine; what has no human origin
- *оуошт*: to worship, prostrate oneself; the most complete act of reverence
- Cf. Job 14:1: "A person born of a woman is short-lived and full of trouble"
- Cf. Matt 11:11 / Luke 7:28: "Among those born of women no one has arisen greater than John" — the Thomas saying inverts the Synoptic by pointing to the one NOT born of woman
- No person born of woman can be the Father — the saying points beyond all human figures
